title: Eathon Lambert's puzzle
summary: Eathon's Puzzle is a key that unlocks the Amulet of Will from its resting place in Atlantis.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Eathon Lambert found the puzzle, but was unable to use it because he never made it to Atlantis, so he left it in a secret room in the Tomb of Nefertiti instead. He drew on the wall a code to find it that only his son, Lok, would be able to solve. [The Sceptre Deception]

Lok discovered it whilst revealing to Cherit in the Tomb of Nefertiti that Sandra Lambert had got him a bird when he was six, contrary to the bicycle, baseball bat and toy he had wanted. [The Sceptre Deception]
